name: appmixer.tldv
label: tl;dv
description: tl;dv is an AI meeting notetaker that joins Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams calls, records them, and produces transcripts and AI-generated notes and summaries. Read meetings, transcripts and notes, download recordings and import external recordings for transcription. API access requires a paid plan (Pro/Business/Enterprise) and depends on the meeting organizer's plan.
